The current Emergency Assistance page lists Monday 11–4 for Campbell and Kenton County residents seeking emergency food, diapers or hygiene items. Confirm hours before travelling, especially around holidays.
On Mondays from 11-4 for Campbell and Kenton County residents needing emergency food, diapers, or hygiene items.
Tuesday and Thursday hours are listed as 12:30–4:30 for help with housing, employment and benefit enrollment; customers can also shop in the emergency choice food pantry during those sessions.

On Tuesdays and Thursdays from 12:30 - 4:30 for customers needing resources such as housing, employment, and benefit enrollments. Customers also have the opportunity to shop for food in our emergency choice food pantry.

Wednesday food assistance is listed from 11–4 for people aged 55 or older from Campbell and Kenton Counties. This is the Wednesday session’s eligibility, not a claim that all pantry service is age-restricted.
On Wednesday from 11-4 for Seniors aged 55 and up from Campbell and Kenton Counties needing food assistance.
Morning Emergency Assistance appointments are offered Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m. Call 859-491-8303 extension 2301 to schedule; the general Service Link number uses extension 2300.
If you would like to schedule an appointment for Emergency Assistance Monday through Friday 8:30 a.m. - 12:30 p.m.,  please call (859) 491-8303 ext. 2301
For more information please contact Service Link (859) 491-8303 ext. 2300
